transcript: Speaker A: Interview mein, main myself Kartik bolkar apna introduction de sakta hoon? [In an interview, can I introduce myself by saying 'myself Kartik'?] Speaker B: Nahi Kartik, myself Kartik se intro start karna galat hai. Uske jagah bolo, I am Kartik or My name is Kartik. [No Kartik, starting an intro with 'myself Kartik' is wrong. Instead, say 'I am Kartik' or 'My name is Kartik'.] Speaker A: Are haan yaar, aise kitni mistakes main roz kar deta hoon. Isiliye English bolne se darr lagta hai. [Oh yes, I make so many such mistakes daily. That's why I'm afraid of speaking English.] Speaker B: Aur isiliye practice zaroori hai. Sirf grammar padhne se ya videos dekhne se English nahi aati, English bolne se aati hai. [And that's why practice is important. You don't learn English just by reading grammar or watching videos, you learn by speaking.] Speaker A: Par practice karu kiske saath? [But who do I practice with?] Speaker B: Isiliye English Seekho App hai. Pehle expert teacher se seekho, phir AI coach ke saath roz English mein baat karo. [That's why there's the English Seekho App. First learn from an expert teacher, then talk in English daily with an AI coach.] Speaker A: Par fees toh zyada hogi na? [But the fees must be high, right?] Speaker B: Bilkul nahi. Sirf Rs. 1 mein English Seekho App ka trial shuru kar sakte ho. [Not at all. You can start a trial of the English Seekho App for just Rs. 1.] Speaker A: Super! Main abhi isi waqt English Seekho App download karta hoon. [Super! I will download the English Seekho App right now.] Speaker B: Kar lo, kyunki agla interview confidently crack karna hai. [Do it, because you have to confidently crack your next interview.] Voiceover: Install Now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho App download karo. [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho App now.]

summary: Two job candidates discuss common English mistakes during interview prep. One recommends the English Seekho App, highlighting its AI coach for judgment-free practice and a trial offer of just 1 Rupee to help users confidently crack interviews.
